He evaluated the job and very clearly explained how he would organize the job and why he was doing it the way he was. He made suggestions as we went along- all while being sincere, understanding, and respectful of my situation. The whole experience felt like I was working with family or a friend instead of a hired service. He really cared about doing the job correctly and with care and efficiency. At one point, he even asked for feedback about my experience booking the service online- all so he could improve the quality and ease of booking online. I highly recommend using this service and I look forward to using it again as I continue to get my parents home ready to sell!
